Report: `docs/research/2026-10-04/release-closure/README.md`. Final product `63ca9d31fe988da9f49abeb78fd98393005a4671`; Linux AMD64 binary SHA256 `d53ddebf5ce8cc4ea898e4d367f9bde0217c9c039cb001f7a499b0288b888818`. Product branch pushed; no release published. Native CI on that exact revision passed all five jobs, including Linux AMD64/ARM64 and macOS Intel/ARM64: [https://github.com/safa-safakhou/diffmind/actions/runs/37222725816](<https://github.com/safa-safakhou/diffmind/actions/runs/37222725816>) . Codex owns all verification; no human sign-off is required.

Reopened from Done after repeated actual-host testing. MCP instructions now distinguish saved company context from an empty local folder (a17e2f7). The main 10-case model cohort at 19bf84e met its bounded DiffMind outcomes. However, four identical vague checkout prompts on that implementation produced two project-selection questions, one explicitly separated comparison, and one false claim that an empty cwd means no architecture evidence (zero MCP calls). Two explicit saved-company-context variants on 63ca9d3 selected correctly, but are a different prompt and do not erase the failure. Some exploratory runs inspected adjacent harness files; these are not blind evaluations. No silent wrong-company selection occurred. Keep adoption reliability open; schemas and one passing session are insufficient.

updates.title: Verify the exact candidate across all three journeys and safeguards
updates.latest_append:
— 4 October 2026

Report: `docs/research/2026-10-04/release-closure/README.md`. Final product `63ca9d31fe988da9f49abeb78fd98393005a4671`; Linux AMD64 binary SHA256 `d53ddebf5ce8cc4ea898e4d367f9bde0217c9c039cb001f7a499b0288b888818`. Product branch pushed; no release published. Native CI on that exact revision passed all five jobs, including Linux AMD64/ARM64 and macOS Intel/ARM64: [https://github.com/safa-safakhou/diffmind/actions/runs/37222725816](<https://github.com/safa-safakhou/diffmind/actions/runs/37222725816>) . Codex owns all verification; no human sign-off is required.

Implemented the handler-body evidence fix (cb2ec52): all six frozen Flask runtime/caller expectations now pass, including the earlier form-field miss (same payload: baseline 200, changed head 400). Actual upstream PR4139 yields one exact caller, with synthetic caller provenance retained. Fixed unreadable native WebKit controls (63ca9d3), found by screenshot inspection despite zero axe findings. Final candidate passes 3 browser engines / 120 observations / 93 axe scans with zero violations or page exceptions, JSON+SQLite automatic refresh (62 jobs, 7008 concurrent-reader requests total, graceful restart), controlled trusted-proxy spoof/revocation checks, native systemd active/inactive backup, and prior-to-current JSON/SQLite recovery. Full Go/race/vet, 60 frontend tests, both builds and dependency/distribution checks pass in the retained candidate/CI records.

Remain In Progress/unreleased: <issue id="da6a5731-a599-41a0-a7f8-02782d40bf04" href="https://linear.app/mnim/issue/MNI-180/guide-agent-onboarding-project-selection-and-evidence-use">MNI-180</issue> is reopened for intermittent unprompted MCP discovery. One upstream PR4139 host review made a false SQLite exception claim; independent runtime execution disproved it. DiffMind's deterministic caller evidence was correct; the host's additional code review was not. A separate PR5918 host finding about routes CLI method mutation was confirmed at its pinned upstream head. Actual Enterprise/production SSO remain unexecuted. Long production soak, screen readers and exhaustive language/protocol accuracy remain explicit coverage limits. Do not substitute the passing main cohort for repeatability or merge safety.
